Art_Theft.title: Theft
Art_Theft.rule_text: The theft article applies to theft conduct. The legal consequence is imprisonment not exceeding 3 years.

Art_Fraud.title: Fraud
Art_Fraud.rule_text: The fraud article applies to fraud conduct. The legal consequence is imprisonment not exceeding 3 years.

Art_Robbery.title: Robbery
Art_Robbery.rule_text: The robbery article applies when theft conduct is accompanied by force or an immediate threat during the taking. The legal consequence is imprisonment between 3 and 10 years.

Art_Aggravated_Theft.title: Aggravated Theft
Art_Aggravated_Theft.rule_text: The aggravated theft article applies when theft conduct involves property of large value. The legal consequence is imprisonment between 3 and 10 years.

Art_Consent_Defense.title: Consent Defense
Art_Consent_Defense.rule_text: The consent defense article applies to taking authorized by the owner. The legal consequence is no criminal liability.

Art_Necessity_Defense.title: Necessity Defense
Art_Necessity_Defense.rule_text: The necessity defense article applies to emergency taking necessary to avoid immediate danger. The legal consequence is no criminal liability.

property_value_large.negative_text: The value of the property was not large.

rules.name: property_facts_imply_property_taking
rules.natural_text: Taking of another person's property is present when the person takes property and that property belongs to another.

rules.name: intent_fact_implies_unlawful_intent
rules.natural_text: Unlawful intent means an intent to keep the property without lawful entitlement.

rules.name: force_or_threat_facts_imply_force_or_threat_during_taking
rules.natural_text: Force or threat during the taking includes either pushing the victim during the taking or threatening immediate harm during the taking.

rules.name: transfer_facts_imply_transferred_property_of_another
rules.natural_text: Transfer of another person's property is present when the victim transfers property and that property belongs to another person.

rules.name: deception_facts_imply_deception_induced_transfer
rules.natural_text: A deception-induced transfer is present when deception causes a transfer of another person's property.

rules.name: large_value_fact_implies_high_value_property
rules.natural_text: High-value property means that the value of the property is large.

rules.name: permission_facts_imply_owner_authorized_taking
rules.natural_text: Owner-authorized taking is present when the person takes the property with the owner's permission.

rules.name: danger_facts_imply_emergency_property_taking
rules.natural_text: Emergency property taking is present when the person takes property as necessary to avoid an immediate danger.

rules.name: property_taking_and_intent_imply_theft_conduct
rules.natural_text: Theft conduct consists of taking another person's property together with unlawful intent.

rules.name: deception_induced_transfer_and_intent_imply_fraud_conduct
rules.natural_text: Fraud conduct consists of a deception-induced transfer of another person's property together with unlawful intent.

rules.name: owner_authorized_taking_implies_consent_defense
rules.natural_text: The consent defense is present when the taking was authorized by the owner.

rules.name: emergency_property_taking_implies_necessity_defense
rules.natural_text: The necessity defense is present when the taking was necessary to avoid an immediate danger.
